cohort: 80 mothers (40 who delivered via cesarean section and 40 who delivered vaginally)
finding: Maternal serum IL-6 levels were significantly higher in mothers who had a vaginal delivery compared to those who had an elective cesarean section.
mod_finding: Maternal serum IL-6 levels were significantly higher in mothers who had a vaginal delivery compared to those who had an elective cesarean section.
